page.content:
Shaolin training ground of Liu Kang and Kung Lao.

How Wu Shi Academy connects

  • Character: Liu Kang — Liu Kang trained at the Wu Shi Academy.
  • Location: Earthrealm — The Wu Shi Academy stands in Earthrealm.
  • Character: Kung Lao — Kung Lao trained at the Wu Shi Academy with Liu Kang.

What is Wu Shi Academy?

The Wu Shi Academy is the Earthrealm temple where Liu Kang and Kung Lao trained before Raiden sent them to Mortal Kombat.

Key threads lead to Liu Kang, Earthrealm and Kung Lao.
